items.question: Patient.Mobile can be null. When the patient has no mobile number on file, is the referral still made without the text (AC3), is it blocked, or is someone (the doctor or the clinic) told to reach the patient another way?

The code covers the clinic inbox being down (the outbox posts later), but there is no text-message dependency at all. If the SMS gateway is slow or down, does the referral still stand, is the text retried, for how long, and who is told if it never goes out?

items.question: If the service stops after the referral is saved but before the patient's text goes out, must the text still be sent later (at least once, accepting a possible second text), or is it fine to send it at most once and sometimes not at all?
